title: RFM Analysis Dashboard
description: E-commerce customer-based RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis with an interactive dashboard built in Power BI. Performed ETL on raw data to identify valuable and at-risk customers.

title: Real Estate Management
description: A Salesforce-based web application for managing and searching real estate properties — property search, user login/signup, email notifications, user dashboard, and property uploads.

title: GetWeather
description: A weather search website that displays real-time weather based on city input, pulling live data from a public weather API.

title: SnapQuest
description: An image search website that allows users to search and dynamically view images based on input, powered by the Unsplash API.
